handoff.objective: Serial prospective snapshots, gate-bound release, exact output custody and tracking-PR publication.
constraints: No experiment before real successful S3 push+gate and frozen committed protocol/source.
No official scientific promotion or main merge; prior auto-merge rejection remains respected.
Serialize commits and stage only declared study/delivery paths; snapshot producer outputs before independent review.
deliverables: Committed+pushed task/source/protocol snapshots and exact hashes
Real checkpoint/gate receipts or precise blocked status
Validated exports/flows, fresh inspected reports/PDFs and tracking PR
completion_gate: All eight tracks have evidence or exact gate/unknown state.
Path digests and raw/export/report values agree.
Tracking branch publication verified; no official claim/state transition.
handoff.return_format: Commits, PR URL, source/protocol hashes, gate outcome and exported flow.
